results.title: ADA Title II Website Compliance for Cities & Towns: 2027 Deadline Guide - Accessibility.Works
results.snippet: The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Title II has prohibited discrimination by state and local governments since 1990. In 2024, the Department of Justice published a final rule explicitly requiring all government websites, SaaS mobile apps and other digital content and properties meet specific accessibility standards. This marks a fundamental shift: municipalities can no longer wait for accommodation requests but must build digital services that are “accessible by default.” The mandate is clear—no resident should be denied access to essential government services because of a disability, whether applying for permits, paying taxes, or accessing emergency information.
